_meta.purpose: The exact tasks and BLS inputs each unscored Business & Finance occupation is scored on. Generated by `npm run generate-bls-scores -- --plan`; the scoring run refuses to start if this file and the data disagree.
_meta.taskSource: O*NET 30.1 (data/db_30_1_text/Task Statements.txt); for SOC 13-2020 the O*NET codes 13-2022.00 and 13-2023.00

rules.first-5-onet-order: The occupation's own .00 tasks, first 5 in O*NET file order (as scripts/extract_new_jobs.cjs did for the published 50).
rules.round-robin-sub-codes: No .00 task list: one task from each O*NET sub-code in turn, in sub-code order, each in O*NET file order.
rules.round-robin-onet-codes: No O*NET code of its own: the O*NET codes it maps to, taken in turn the same way.

_meta.growthNote: Vintage mismatch: the shared prompt calls this figure the BLS Occupational Outlook 2024-2034 change; the value passed is the BLS Employment Projections 2025-2035 change, the only projection the repository holds for these occupations. Both are 10-year totals in percent from the same BLS programme. The prompt text was not changed, so the method matches the published set.
